description.text: Teaching ObjectivesAfter graduation you will be qualified senior and comprehensive engineering technicians in the areas of production technology and research, engineering construction, industrial enterprises trade, and administrative management and training and so forth.Main course Engineering Economics,Computer Usage,Engineering Graphics,Test and Control Technology,Strength of Materials, Machine Design Production Planning and Control Electrical and Electronics Production and Manufacturing systemInternshipMetalworking, mechanical drawing, mechanical design, electrical engineering and electronics practice, computer measurement and control technology of comprehensive practice, professional practice, professional design, graduation design etc.Degree AwardedBachelor Degree of Engineering.Future CareerAfter graduation you can be comprehensive senior engineers to design mechatronics system, do manufacture or develop new technology in the enterprises or research institute.

duration.text: The Mechancial Engineering and Automation at Ningbo University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 2777 USD/per year ￥ 20000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1.Photocopy of valid passportWith photo, passport number &expiration date and name included.2.Passport-sized photoA passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant3. High school's certificateGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4.Transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1. High school graduate or above, or have passed Grade Twelve (10+2)/FSc./A Level/WAEC or equivalent. 2. Aged 18 or above and with a good health3. No Chinese-citizen with foreign passport
